summary: First Financial Corporation filed an 8-K/A to correct a Rule 425 checkbox error, disclosing its Agreement and Plan of Merger with First Illinois Corporation. Under the terms, each First Illinois share converts into either 0.5727 FFC shares or $44.35 cash, with 70% stock and 30% cash mix, subject to adjustment if First Illinois' adjusted equity falls below $82.4 million. Boards approved unanimously; merger expected Q4 2026. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder votes; arbitrageurs should monitor equity adjustment and closing conditions.
